hotels.title: Five-Star Gaya Island Beachfront Hideaway off the Coast of Borneo
hotels.description: Located just off the coast of Borneo's Kota Kinabalu, Bungaraya Island Resort is a five-star secluded hideaway just steps from the white-sand beach of Gaya Island’s Polish Bay. Here, just 48 timber villas reflecting traditional Bornean architecture are nestled amid the lush greenery of a tropical jungle. Lounge by the sparkling infinity pool and take in views of the shimmering ocean beyond or visit the luxurious Echo Wellness Spa, where restorative treatments await. The alfresco The Longhouse Restaurant serves up traditional cuisine alongside a mix of local fare, while The Longhouse Wine Cellar is the perfect place to find your new favorite tipple.

hotels.title: Tranquil Borneo Villas with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner, Cocktails & Return Speedboat Transfers
hotels.description: Discover the unspoiled tropical beauty of Borneo's Gaya Island at this tranquil eco hotel within the protected Tunku Abdul Rahman Marine Park. This cluster of islands, just a 10-minute speedboat ride off the coast of Kota Kinabalu, envelops you in the splendour of Borneo’s famed rainforests, where secluded villas overlook sparkling bays. A member of the prestigious Small Luxury Hotels of the World collection, this beachfront haven offers moments of relaxation alongside immersive experiences, such as coral reef snorkelling and guided nature walks. Take a boat or short hike to a private beach and leave the world behind with only sun, sand and wildlife like proboscis monkeys for company. Savour sumptuous and sustainable seafood dishes at Fisherman's Cove, marvel at sunset views over Mount Kinabalu from the two-storey Omakase restaurant or cool off with a refreshing tipple by the pool. Whenever you need to revitalise your body and mind, visit the resort's Spa Village or simply drink in breathtaking vistas from your dreamy villa.
